query.default: select distinct employee.persnumber_company_sungero as persnumber, employee."name" as employeeName, jobTitle."name" as jobTitleName, vacationsinfor.structuraldepa as departmentName from dirrx_nnvacat_vacationsinfor as vacationsinfor join sungero_core_recipient as employee on employee.id = vacationsinfor.employee join sungero_company_jobTitle as jobTitle on jobTitle.id = employee.jobtitle_company_sungero where not @Consent and vacationsinfor.businessunit = @BusinessUnitId and extract(year from vacationsinfor."year") = @Year and (@DepartmentId = 0 or vacationsinfor.department = @DepartmentId) and employee.consenthrpro_hrproso_hrpro != 'Signed' order by employeeName

select distinct employee.persnumber_company_sungero as persnumber, employee."name" as employeeName, jobTitle."name" as jobTitleName, doc.structuraldepa_overrid_dirrx as departmentName from sungero_content_edoc as doc join sungero_core_recipient as employee on employee.id = doc.employeedirrx_overrid_dirrx join sungero_company_jobTitle as jobTitle on jobTitle.id = employee.jobtitle_company_sungero where @Consent and doc.acquiantanceop_overrid_dirrx = 'Electronic' and doc.businessunit_docflow_sungero = @BusinessUnitId and extract(year from doc.year1_vacatio_hrpro) = @Year and (@DepartmentId = 0 or doc.department_docflow_sungero = @DepartmentId) and doc.intapprstate_docflow_sungero = 'Aborted' and doc.documentkind_docflow_sungero = @DocKindId order by employeeName
